description.value: The BC Wine Information Centre has served as the official gateway to BC wine country since 1996, operated by a not-for-profit society that reinvests all proceeds into wine education, scholarships, and bursaries for viticulture students. It carries wines from over 170 BC wineries and regularly hosts in-store tastings featuring guest wineries. For cyclists touring the Okanagan's wine routes, it offers curated gourmet products, gift baskets, and a WSET-certified staff to guide selections.

address.value: 553 Vees Dr Unit 101, Penticton, BC V2A 8S3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pentictonwineinfo.com clearly identifies the business as 'BC Wine Information Centre' — not 'VQA Wine Store' as recorded in OSM — and provides a full address of 553 Vees Dr Unit 101, Penticton, BC V2A 8S3, which contradicts the OSM address field of '400'. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields are null. The business is actively operating with upcoming 2026 events listed.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'VQA Wine Store' but the website clearly and consistently identifies the business as 'BC Wine Information Centre'. The OSM name appears to be outdated or refer to a former branding.

Address discrepancy: OSM address field contains only '400' (an incomplete house number), while the website shows '553 Vees Dr Unit 101, Penticton, BC V2A 8S3'. These are different house numbers (400 vs. 553); the website address has been used as it is more complete and current.
OSM has no phone number on record; phone was sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating wine retail and education centre in the heart of Okanagan cycling and wine country; a natural and valuable stop for touring cyclists on BC wine routes.
